purpose: A sworn written statement of fact made under oath before an authorized officer (e.g. Oath Commissioner, Notary Public).

common_fields.description: Full legal name of the person giving the sworn statement under penalty of perjury.
common_fields.simple_urdu: بیان حلفی دینے والے شخص کا مکمل قانونی نام۔

common_fields.description: Official national identity registration number of the deponent.
common_fields.simple_urdu: قومی شناختی کارڈ یا پاسپورٹ نمبر۔

common_fields.description: Formal clause affirming that contents of the affidavit are true and correct to the best of knowledge.
common_fields.simple_urdu: تصدیقی بیان کہ جو کچھ درج ہے وہ سچ ہے اور کچھ چھپایا نہیں گیا۔

typical_supporting_docs: Original National ID / Passport
Witness signatures with valid identity copies
Official Stamp of Notary Public or Oath Commissioner
important_notes: Never sign a blank affidavit. Knowingly false statements in an affidavit constitute the criminal offense of perjury.

purpose: A legal instrument authorizing one designated person (the agent/attorney) to act on behalf of another (the principal).

common_fields.description: The person granting legal authority to someone else.
common_fields.simple_urdu: وہ شخص جو دوسرے کو اپنے معاملات کا اختیار سونپ رہا ہے (موکل)۔

common_fields.description: The trusted person authorized to exercise the legal powers on behalf of the principal.
common_fields.simple_urdu: وہ شخص جس کو کام کرنے کا باضابطہ اختیار سونپا جا رہا ہے (مختارِ عام یا خاص)۔

common_fields.description: Exact enumerations of permitted acts (e.g., property management, banking, court representation).
common_fields.simple_urdu: سونپے گئے مخصوص اختیارات کی تفصیل۔

typical_supporting_docs: Valid Identity documents for Principal and Attorney
Two adult witnesses with identity copies
Official Registration / Stamp Paper where required by local registry laws
important_notes: A Special Power of Attorney is safer than a General Power of Attorney as it restricts authority to specific named transactions.

purpose: Official administrative application form for obtaining corporate identity or tax enrollment.

common_fields.description: Sole proprietorship, partnership (AOP), or limited liability company.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کاروبار کی قانونی حیثیت (انفرادی، شراکت داری یا کمپنی)۔

common_fields.description: Physical commercial premises where official notices will be served.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کاروبار کا باضابطہ رجسٹرڈ پتہ۔

common_fields.description: Standard industrial classification code or description of primary commercial operations.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کاروبار یا سروسز کی بنیادی نوعیت۔

typical_supporting_docs: Utility bills of commercial premises / Rent agreement
Bank maintenance certificate
Directors or Partners CNIC / Identity cards
important_notes: Verify regulatory filing deadlines to avoid initial late-filing non-compliance penalties.

purpose: A legal contract granting occupancy of real property by a landlord to a tenant for a specified duration in exchange for periodic rent payments.

common_fields.description: Full legal name, CNIC/Passport, and ownership proof of the property owner.
common_fields.simple_urdu: مالک مکان یا جائیداد کے مالک کا مکمل نام اور شناختی کوائف۔

common_fields.description: Full legal name, national identity number, and permanent address of the tenant.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کرایہ دار کا مکمل قانونی نام اور مستقل پتہ۔

common_fields.description: Complete physical address, plot number, covered area, and fixtures included in the tenancy.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کرائے پر دی جانے والی جائیداد کا مکمل پتہ اور حدودِ اربعہ۔

common_fields.description: Agreed monthly rental amount, due date (e.g. 5th of each month), and annual percentage increase (typically 10%).
common_fields.simple_urdu: ماہانہ کرایہ، تاریخِ ادائیگی اور سالانہ اضافے کی شرح (جیسے دس فیصد)۔

common_fields.description: Refundable security deposit amount held against damage or unpaid utility bills.
common_fields.simple_urdu: زرِ ضمانت (سیکیورٹی ڈپازٹ) جو معاہدے کے خاتمے پر قابلِ واپسی ہوگی۔

common_fields.description: Allocation of structural repairs to landlord vs day-to-day minor repairs and utilities to tenant.
common_fields.simple_urdu: بجلی، گیس، پانی کے بلوں اور عمارت کی مرمت کی ذمہ داریوں کی تقسیم۔

typical_supporting_docs: Original or Certified Copy of Title Deed / Registry / Allotment Letter
Valid CNIC copies of Landlord, Tenant, and two respectable witnesses
Police Station Tenant Verification Form / Clearance Certificate
Prescribed Stamp Paper of appropriate value according to the Stamp Act
important_notes: Under Tenancy Acts, registration of the tenancy agreement with the local Rent Tribunal or Rent Registrar is legally mandatory for enforcement of summary eviction procedures.

form_type: SECP Form 29 (Particulars of Directors, Officers & Auditors)
purpose: Statutory corporate return filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission notifying appointments, resignations, or changes of corporate directors and officers.

common_fields.description: Official company registration number assigned by the corporate registry.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کمپنی کا کارپوریٹ رجسٹریشن نمبر۔

common_fields.field_name: Full Legal Name of the Company
common_fields.description: Exact name of the registered corporate entity as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کمپنی کا باضابطہ رجسٹرڈ نام۔

common_fields.description: Identity and nationality details of the incoming or resigning director/CEO.
common_fields.simple_urdu: عہدے پر فائز ہونے والے یا مستعفی ڈائریکٹر یا چیف ایگزیکٹو کا نام اور شناختی نمبر۔

common_fields.description: Exact calendar date when the appointment took effect or resignation was accepted.
common_fields.simple_urdu: تقرری یا استعفے کی حتمی تاریخ۔

common_fields.field_name: Mode of Change / Board Resolution Reference
common_fields.description: Reference to Board of Directors resolution or AGM election approving the change.
common_fields.simple_urdu: بورڈ کی قرارداد یا اجلاس کا حوالہ جس میں یہ فیصلہ منظور ہوا۔

typical_supporting_docs: Certified Copy of Board Resolution or AGM Minutes
Consent to Act as Director (Form 28)
CNIC/Passport copy of the new Director
Official payment receipt of SECP filing fees
important_notes: Statutory corporate laws mandate filing Form 29 within 14 to 15 days of any change in the board of directors; late filings attract statutory penal surcharges.

form_type: Deed of Sale of Immovable Property (Sale Deed / Bayanama)
purpose: A registered deed effecting the absolute and irrevocable legal transfer of ownership of real estate from seller to buyer for valuable consideration.

common_fields.description: Full name, parentage, CNIC, and current residential address of the lawful titleholder.
common_fields.simple_urdu: فروخت کنندہ (بائع) کا مکمل نام، ولدیت اور شناختی کارڈ نمبر۔

common_fields.description: Full name, parentage, CNIC, and permanent address of the incoming buyer.
common_fields.simple_urdu: خریدار (مشتری) کا مکمل نام، ولدیت اور قومی شناختی نمبر۔

common_fields.description: Exact demarcations: North, South, East, West boundaries, Khasra/Plot number, and registry records.
common_fields.simple_urdu: جائیداد کے حدودِ اربعہ، خسرہ یا پلاٹ نمبر اور رقبے کی تفصیل۔

common_fields.description: The exact monetary price paid, pay-order/bank cheque numbers, and full acknowledgment of receipt.
common_fields.simple_urdu: فروخت کی کل رقم، پے آرڈر یا بینک چیک کی تفصیل اور وصولی کی تصدیق۔

common_fields.description: Seller's sworn covenant that the property is free from all mortgages, liens, disputes, or tax claims.
common_fields.simple_urdu: مالک کی طرف سے ضمانت کہ جائیداد ہر قسم کے تنازعے اور قرض سے پاک ہے۔

typical_supporting_docs: Fard Malkiat / Ownership Mutation Certificate from Revenue Office
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Housing Authority or Municipal Council
E-Stamp Paper of requisite value based on DC valuation table
Tax payment receipts (Section 236K / 236C withholding tax)
Two adult male witnesses with original CNICs
important_notes: A Sale Deed of immovable property worth over Rs. 100 must be compulsorily registered before the Sub-Registrar under the Registration Act to convey legal title.

form_type: Partnership Deed (Form A / Form B Registration)
purpose: A founding constitutional deed between two or more partners establishing rights, profit-sharing ratios, capital contributions, and operational rules of a partnership firm.

common_fields.description: The trade name under which business is conducted and the headquarters address.
common_fields.simple_urdu: شراکت داری فرم کا تجارتی نام اور مرکزی دفتر کا پتہ۔

common_fields.description: Specific commercial activities and services authorized under the partnership.
common_fields.simple_urdu: کاروبار اور تجارتی سرگرمیوں کی نوعیت۔

common_fields.description: Amount of money, property, or equipment invested by each individual partner.
common_fields.simple_urdu: ہر شریک کا لگایا گیا سرمایہ اور اس کی مالی شرح۔

common_fields.description: The exact contractual percentage for distribution of net profits and absorption of financial losses.
common_fields.simple_urdu: نفع اور نقصان کی باہمی تقسیم کا تناسب۔

common_fields.description: Specification whether bank accounts require joint signatures or sole partner operations.
common_fields.simple_urdu: بینک اکاؤنٹس چلانے اور دستخط کرنے کا اختیار۔

common_fields.description: Rules for goodwill valuation, accounts settlement, and dissolution notices.
common_fields.simple_urdu: فرم کے خاتمے یا کسی شریک کی علیحدگی کی صورت میں حساب کتاب کا طریقہ کار۔

typical_supporting_docs: Non-judicial stamp paper of prescribed state stamp duty value
Attested CNIC copies of all partners and witnesses
Rent agreement or ownership proof of principal commercial premises
Form I registration application submitted to the Registrar of Firms
important_notes: Unregistered partnership firms are legally barred under the Partnership Act from filing lawsuits in court to enforce contractual claims against third parties.

purpose: A legally binding contract between an employer and employee defining job duties, compensation, benefits, termination rules, and confidentiality.

common_fields.description: Official designation and direct managerial reporting line.
common_fields.simple_urdu: ملازمت کا عہدہ اور ڈائریکٹ رپورٹنگ مینیجر۔

common_fields.description: Detailed compensation breakdown: basic salary, house rent, medical allowance, and bonuses.
common_fields.simple_urdu: تنخواہ، الاؤنسز اور دیگر مالی مراعات کی تفصیل۔

common_fields.description: Initial evaluation duration (typically 3 to 6 months) during which termination requires shorter notice.
common_fields.simple_urdu: آزمائشی مدت (پروبیشن پیریڈ) جس میں کارکردگی کا جائزہ لیا جاتا ہے۔

common_fields.description: Required written notice period (e.g. 30 days) or payment of salary in lieu of notice.
common_fields.simple_urdu: ملازمت ختم کرنے کا تحریری نوٹس پیریڈ یا اس کے بدلے تنخواہ کی ادائیگی۔

common_fields.description: Clause vesting full ownership of all patents, software, designs, and code created on the job into the employer.
common_fields.simple_urdu: دورانِ ملازمت تخلیق کردہ تمام سافٹ ویئر اور ایجادات کے حقوق کمپنی کو سونپنا۔

typical_supporting_docs: Educational degrees and professional qualification certificates
Previous employer relieving certificate / experience letters
CNIC copy and criminal background verification
important_notes: Statutory labor and employment laws supersede contractual terms that fall below minimum wage, maximum working hours, or statutory leave entitlements.
